baseInputConfiguration.description: Base editable html input configuration regarding plugins that are enabled/disabled E.g. audio, video, image

expandedInput.description: Expanded input configurations: only `inputConfiguration` is read, for the standards, description and score point descriptor editors

labelInput.description: Label input configurations: only `inputConfiguration` is read, for the trait name, trait label and score point label editors

excludeZeroDialogBoxContent.description: Not read by the element: the dialog shows its built-in text

includeZeroDialogBoxContent.description: Not read by the element: the dialog shows its built-in text

deleteScaleDialogBoxContent.description: Not read by the element: the dialog shows its built-in text

maxPointsDialogBoxContent.description: Not read by the element: the dialog shows its built-in text

settingsPanelDisabled.description: Indicates if the settings panel is not available

showScorePointLabels.description: Configuration for Showing Score Point Labels

showVisibleToStudent.description: Configuration for Showing Multi-trait-rubric to Students

showHalfScoring.description: Configuration for Showing Half Scoring Indicator

spellCheck.description: Configuration for the author's spellcheck: `enabled` is not read, the model's `spellCheckEnabled` sets it

showStandards.description: Configuration for showing the Standards column

showLevelTagInput.description: Configuration for showing the Level Tag Input; `enabled` shows it

dragAndDrop.description: Configuration for allowing drag & drop per traits; `enabled` allows it

showMaxPoint.description: Configuration for the Settings Panel toggle of the model's `maxPointsEnabled`

addScale.description: Configuration for the Settings Panel toggle of the model's `addScaleEnabled`

width.description: How large (in px) should multi-trait-rubric be; without it the rubric takes the container's width

defaultTraitLabel.description: The default trait label for new created scales. If it's not defined, it will default to the label of the first trait.

maxMaxPoints.description: Indicates the max limit for scoring points

customPlugins.description: An array of objects that determine custom plugins. A custom plugin is an object which determines how the button will look like (icon) and the event name that will be triggered when the button gets pressed (event).

EditableHtmlConfigureProp.description: Toolbar plugins of an editable-html field, keyed by plugin name.

disabled.description: Indicates if the plugin is disabled or not

event.description: The name of the custom event. It needs to be valid (only letters, numbers and "_" can be used). The event is emitted with the "PIE-" prefix.

iconAlt.description: The alt for the custom button icon

iconType.description: The icon type. Currently, only "SVG" is supported.

icon.description: The icon string. Currently, only SVG is supported, so it needs to be a valid svg.

settings.description: Indicates if the item has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

label.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

ConfigureProp.description:
Building blocks of an element's authoring configuration: the object a host passes to the `<tag>-config` custom element to decide which settings the author sees and how editors behave.

Each element declares its own `<Name>Configuration` interface from these, and its JSON Schema is generated from that interface. Descriptions are carried over from the legacy `pie-elements` config schemas, so they appear in the generated schemas unchanged.

settings.description: Indicates if the item has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

label.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

enabled.description: Indicates the value of the item if it affects config-ui (eg.: if item is a switch and displaying an input on the config-ui depends on the switch value: on/off)

ContentDimensions.description: Indicates the dimensions configuration for the authoring container. Note: Some items have a default minimum width because of their content, but if a lower minWidth is provided, it will be used.

mmlOutput.description: Indicates if model should have mathML output instead of latex

mmlEditing.description: Indicates if mathML that's already in model should be editable
